entities.summary: The Tianjin Olympic Centre, often colloquially referred to as the Water Drop, is a sports complex with a multi-use stadium named Tianjin Olympic Centre Stadium in Tianjin, China. Construction started in August 2003 and was completed in August 2007. It was the home stadium of Tianjin Jinmen Tiger.
